reports.title: SSV - Brewster rock
reports.comment: quick: Really good early season conditions at Sunshine. You can skin up directly from the parking lot (although thin all the way up to Goat's Eye). Best skiing was found between Angel Express and TP Town chairs. Higher up in the alpine towards the top of the Divide chair, a good 15cm of pow overlying a really supportive 3cm crust with another 15-20cm underneath (didn't analyze, but I'd figure that…

reports.title: Where's the ... crust ? SSV Rock Isle Lake
reports.comment: quick: Hot lapped Rock Isle Lake out of SSV slack country a few times, between 2250-2400m North facing. No Halloween crust to be found - just bottomless facets (already). Was hoping for a bit more support but the rocky terrain and extended cold spell seems to have faceted everything out in no time flat. Still pretty amazing early season conditions. HS varied between 50-60cm.

reports.title: Base of twin cairns
reports.comment: quick: Toured at the base of twin cairns from the Standish chair. Profile at 2400m on E aspect gave similar resuts as earlier reports - CT12 SP down on the halloween crust on the 30’ test slope we were on. Snow was definitely upside down - HS 87cm - 3 really obvious crusts - entire snowpack (including facets below halloween crust) were moist. We just dialed it back big time and in any case, snow w…

reports.title: Healy Pass, Banff NP
reports.comment: quick: Very thin coverage from Sunshine parking lot but quickly improved with elevation. 130cm+ base at pass with about 30cm+ of new snow on a supportive crust. Temps for the day -8C from parking lot, -9C at the pass, -3C back at parking lot at 3pm. Everything stable with no signs of natural avalanche activity.

reports.title: Sunshine Snow profile
reports.comment: snowpack: SH well intact at the study plot

reports.title: Healy Pass
reports.comment: snowpack: CTE 8 (SC) down 35 on facets and SH, 2nd test CTN. 35cm 4F soft slab overlies of this weak layer.

reports.title: Healy Pass
reports.comment: snowpack: woomfing and settlements up to 50m wide on both N and S aspects of Healy Pass. Well developed slab failing easy on dec 15 layer.  Skied very mellow terrain 20 degrees and less.

reports.title: auto: Quick Report
reports.comment: quick: Went for a walk out by rock Isle lake and twin cairns. Good snow quality all day but could see SH and facet layer about 30-35 cm down. We cut a convex little pocket and it slid on the PWL on a westerly aspect exactly where you would expect.

reports.title: SSV backcountry
reports.comment: quick: The Jan. 6 buried surface hoar layer deserves respect. We had ontinuous settlements all day, all aspects with shooting cracks to 10m+ and activation of tree bombs.  Stomped on a few small steep convex slopes and easily triggered releases with remote propagation to other features. reports.title: SSV Meadows
reports.comment:
quick: Toured SSV meadows as we pulled the pin on Twin Cairns traverse due to the high winds. Dug a profile, 2358m, East aspect, HS 125cm, CTM11 SC down 35 on SH. Results were easily repeated. PST 40/100 END down 35 on SH again. Some settlement and cracking as we just took it easy along the ridge. Descended repeater slopes - mix of sun crust followed by powder.

Noticed what seemed like a size 1.5…

reports.title: Slide on the back side of Wawa (sunshine village)
reports.comment: quick: We witnessed this one let go. Luckily it was small and we weren’t near by. Skinned in for a closer look and to take the pics. The boarding was awesome but I would definitely keep to the mellow stuff if you’re going to head off the back side towards Healy Creek.

reports.title: SSV Grizzly Trees
reports.comment: quick: Good snow in Grizzly trees. No significant obs but the crown on the East face of Twin Cairns that ran earlier this week was still visible and commanded respect. Snow in alpine was wind affected so we stayed in trees. Grizzly had some great snow especially where the summer fires raged. Winds picked up significantly from NNE in pm which made return quite unpleasant. Pit on S aspect didnt yiel…

reports.title: Healy Pass/ Monarch Ramparts
reports.comment: quick: Weekend at Healy Pass area - new snow Feb 25 made for some great skiing off of Monarch Ramparts. Quite a bit of variability but some powder to be found. Skied 35-40 degree slopes Feb 24 and found no signs of instability but rode some pretty variable hardpacked snow with pockets of powder from wind transfer. reports.title: South Twins and Rock Isle
reports.comment:
quick: Found less then ideal conditions on east facing slopes with a 5cm hard crust buried below 8-10cm for new storm snow in the morning.
We moved over to Northfacing slopes in the afternoon and found 20-30cms of storm snow which made for excellent conditions. 
No recent activity was seen. Temperature stayed relatively stable at around -5 to 0 degrees all day.

reports.title: Slushy skiing - at Sunshine
reports.comment: quick: Likely one of the last posts of the season. Just couldn't hang up the skis so my 12 yr old son and I decided to bike up the Sunshine access road with our gear. After a 500m vertical slog, we finally got to the base village of Sunshine where there was still plenty of snow. The road is dry but next year, I'm thinking an eBike is in order !
